subject: Acknowledged and recorded: the source foundation kept apart from writing, readiness and result (Addendum B); section 11 for the ten opening cards; the rebuilt scope-A text for the opening; S03-1 and S03-2 delivered
body:
Acknowledged: a block's source foundation is the maturity of the one explicitly selected complete scene image (or of each selected required input by role), read from the record's stage and hash; it is kept apart from the shot's authoring maturity, its technical readiness and the actual video's acceptance; a mature frame saves preparation and establishes nothing of the new action, camera, timing, lip sync or result; a linked panel or an accepted component is never a starting frame; unrecorded is its own state; from scratch is not a failure; other modes report each required input by role and never the highest stage; a new input hash flags dependent checks and packs for review and rewrites nothing; not a new approval gate, and the October 12 method stands. Recorded in Addendum B using 11.2 (the foundation line, in the site's state labels), 11.9 (the foundation consequence) and 11.12 (the foundation decisions and the input-change rule, beside Addendum A's 2.5), and applied to every block written from here on. The record today: twenty-three blocks carry section 11 and every one reads No starting frame selected; the foundation line itself stands in 11.2 of the twelve blocks written in this handback (the ten opening blocks and S03-1 and S03-2) and is written for S01-1 beside the posted example; the posted S02 blocks are not edited, and the table in Addendum B Part 3 gives every block's required inputs by role with their maturity as review_decisions.json records it (mouth B production detail; face A stage not recorded, selection recorded; the boss production cast; the cockpit candidate preliminary, bound as inspiration only; the inspiration panels stage: none, except SB-03, keep 2026-10-09, stage not recorded; the DJ beast sheet stage: none). From scratch and Not required are read by the site from its bindings record alone (storyboard_input_bindings.json, empty today); the writer's from-scratch intent in a block is a plan, not that record. Your two examples are written in block terms in Part 3. The 70-shot structure is not promoted by anything here.

One correction to a posted file, mine: the improvement round's section D gives SB-01 a review "keep"; review_decisions.json (updated 02:13 UTC, 320 items) holds no entry for SB-01 by id or hash and the catalog's review block does not include it; corrected to "none" in Addendum B Part 4 and in the delta v3 note; the posted file stands.

The planned writing continued: section 11 for the ten opening cards (OPENING_KITCHEN_BLOCKS_20261029.md), with three set-only prompts the packet's order of work already calls for (the landing; the cantina from the booth's side and from the entrance, one room) and one figure still it also calls for (the partner at the boards in that room, written as 7s-b, after the room still is reviewed), proposals, nothing requested; the rebuilt scope-A text for the opening (HON_OPENING_SOURCE_TEXT_20261029.txt): the posted packet with the record's working names replaced by descriptions, each shot's 11.1, 11.3, 11.9 and foundation line inserted, the cold-reader summary, the decision snapshot, the event register, the manifest by hash and the rules; a text Source candidate for your placement and readback after Ziggy's item 17, not uploaded; and S03-1 and S03-2 with kitchen blocks (S03_PACKET_20261029.md). Site Nova's publication of today, as you report it and as SITE_INDEX_RESULT.json records (the Structure and gaps view, the blank template, 320 reviews preserved), and your verification of my four 13:01 attachments (WRITER_INPUT_VERIFICATION.json, 13:32 UTC) are recorded in Addendum B Part 5; site ownership stays with Site Nova and nothing here asks for a site edit.

Asked of your lane, to ride with this message and answered at dispatch, not now: the beat grid for S03 beside S02's; and, when the first STILL PREP is near, which route you choose for the common frame, so the record's first foundation enters with its route named. Also sent to cfa_site_index: delta v3, additive to v2 (four links, the publication list and one preview asset; no new question). Nothing generated, uploaded, bought, opened or activated. Next writing: S04-1 to S04-7; then S05 and S08 as the ignition card.

attachments.description: Addendum B: the source foundation of a block, kept apart from its authoring maturity, its technical readiness and its result; the foundation line in 11.2, the consequence lines in 11.9 and 11.12; the state of all twenty-three blocks; one correction to the improvement round (SB-01 review: none, not keep); the site publication recorded (proposal).

Section 11 KITCHEN for the ten opening cards that lacked it, P-1 to S01-3, with the foundation line; S01-1's foundation line written beside the posted example, which is unchanged; three set-only prompts for the landing and the cantina's two axes and one figure still, the partner at the boards (proposals).

The rebuilt scope-A text for the opening: the posted packet with the record's working names replaced, each shot's 11.1, 11.3, 11.9 and foundation line inserted, plus the cold-reader summary, the decision snapshot, the event register, the manifest and the rules. A text Source candidate; not uploaded; dispatch is card item 17.
Second-chorus packet: S03-1 and S03-2 in the shot-direction structure, each with a kitchen block (proposal).

Card delta v3, additive to v2 (carried into the site's missionControl catalog today, per SITE_INDEX_RESULT.json): four links, the publication list and one preview asset; no new question; items 14 to 17 unchanged.

source: CFA Nova's coordination note of 2026-10-29 (SOURCE_MATURITY_TO_CLAUDE.txt) at Ziggy's idea, with the root rules SOURCE_MATURITY_RULES_20261029.txt and the site index result of the same day; verified against the files named in Addendum B.
